newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Feb trade surplus widens to $4.7 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Feb trade surplus widens to $4.7 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $4.7 billion in the first two months of this year after a $3.0 billion surplus in the same period of 1996, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
Total trade, including other members of CIS:
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Feb 97 Jan 97 Jan-Feb 96
Excluding trade with other members of CIS:
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Feb 97 Jan 97 Jan-Feb 96
Notes -- Figures in billion dollars, FOB. The committee previously estimated the total surplus for the first two months of this year at $4.6 billion.
